name: Project FROST
source:
Under the glare of an unknown scientist, you wake up in an empty and cold laboratory with no memories of your past self. What happened to the world? Who are these people? What are you doing there? 

Ask questions to discover the truth about what happened to humanity while you were unconscious, or leave your past behind to start a new life.

[from [url=https://cryogenic-games.itch.io/frost]itch.io[/url]]
